featured_reviews.name: Shreshth Mohan Bhatnagar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined iSchoolPrep just few days prior before my IELTS Test and during my classes with them all my topics were well covered, extremely qualified faculty, the classes were very interactive practice questions were given followed my personal reviewing. The one on one sessions were the main thing that helped me the most, the guide, Arash Kashyap was wonderful at explaining and was very patient with me, each and every topic was covered by her personally.
I cleared my exam with such an amazing score only under her guidance at iSchoolPrep

featured_reviews.name: Salam Denilson Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I am lucky enough that Ischoolconnect assigned Ma'am Shreya Nandi as the IELTS Mentor for me. I took IELTS class for a month from Ma'am Shreya which helped me to prepare for all the situations for the IELTS exam. I had given my exam and it went very well thanks to the tips that Ma'am had taught to me. Her lessons were engaging, very useful, and she was very patient with me by encouraging me everytime. I highly recommend Ma'am Shreya to anyone who is really interested in getting a high score band in IELTS. Lastly, Thank you so much again for your support and helping me to achieve my goals.

featured_reviews.name: Nehal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great mentor who guided me through my IELTS prep and is also my Verbal tutor- Ms. Shreya Nandi. Overall, ischoolprep follows all the material from the official guide and all the mentors are very approachable in case of any kind of doubts. I have recently started my classes so can only write about my journey so far. So far, quite good.

featured_reviews.name: Srijan Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Marks scored - L=7.0,R=8.0,W=7.0,S=7.0,OverAll=7.5
Best institute for IELTS preparation for online, highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: mrinal gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: I bought the foundation course as a way for prepration before giving my ielts exam but the entire course was really bad. The site had some sort of software issues that the company did not feel the right to disclose before taking our money. The course was made up of two things : overview of the ielts paper which was an exact copy of the free ielts coursebook you get upon registering for ielts and pratical questions which had some sort or the other issue. Like the listening audio does not play out while going through questions. The reading font size is huge that you cannot navigate through the questions and answers.

featured_reviews.name: parvati ramachandran
featured_reviews.review_text: A very well designed course, easy to follow and remember. The tutors are friendly and approachable. I highly recommend iSchoolPrep for anyone who is looking to prepare for their IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT or SAT exams.

featured_reviews.name: Ruhail Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent experience. Complete information is provided with regards to preparation for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, GRE & GMAT coaching. If you are looking to go abroad & looking for study material this is website you can enroll & score excellent marks in your exams

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: iSchoolPrep is very easy and informative platform to learn about the study abroad exams like IELTS, TOEFL. I would like to recommend everyone to visit the app and website for any assistance with the test prep prepration.

featured_reviews.review_text: My visa counselor, Ms. Arati Chavan, provided excellent support throughout the entire process. She was highly professional, helpful, and consistently polite. I am extremely satisfied with the guidance and assistance I received.

featured_reviews.name: Mayank Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined mainly for application support and SOP guidance. The team was quite structured in how they approached things, especially deadlines. They pushed me when I was being lazy, which I honestly needed. Not everything was perfect, but I never felt lost during the process. End result was good, so I’d say it was worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Aravinda Krishnan Narayanan Pon
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience with Collegepond while applying for my UK studies. Ms.Arati Chavan guided me through the entire process, from the visa application to all the necessary steps, making everything smooth and stress-free. Her clear guidance and constant support helped me understand exactly what to do and when. I truly appreciate the assistance and would definitely recommend Collegepond to others.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Parkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Collegepond has been outstanding. From the very start, I felt a genuine sense of care and commitment from the entire team, led by Jimeet Sir, whose clarity and focus set the tone for everyone. His approach is not about pushing students towards popular universities, but about finding the best-fit options based on individual goals and strengths.
This same level of dedication extends across all departments — from SOPs and LORs to overall counseling. The team is well-organized, responsive, and incredibly efficient. They strike the perfect balance between personal attention and professional execution, making what is usually a stressful process feel smooth and manageable.
What sets Collegepond apart is their consistency, transparency, and genuine passion for helping students succeed. If you're planning to study abroad and want expert support with heart, I highly recommend Collegepond.
